controls.label: Separation depth
controls.evaluatorConsequence: Scales per-plane z offsets around the source plane.
controls.renderConsequence: Changes depth legibility without changing source pixels or lateral positions.
controls.causalTest: At inspection hold, far-plane z span changes monotonically; resolved pose remains zero.

controls.label: Lateral spread
controls.renderConsequence: Changes silhouette separation; source plane remains intact.
controls.causalTest: At t=0.5, maximum x/y offset changes; t=0 and t=1 stay exact zero.

controls.label: Perspective
controls.renderConsequence: Changes depth readability only; no camera translation or source deformation.
controls.causalTest: Stage rotation changes while all local plane path vectors and source hash remain invariant.

controls.label: Inspection hold
controls.renderConsequence: Changes dwell only; full-separated pose is unchanged.
controls.causalTest: Hold boundary state remains progress 1 and velocity 0 while duration changes exactly.

controls.label: Labels
controls.evaluatorConsequence: Declares label presentation state; structure list stays accessible.
controls.renderConsequence: Shows Project-known names, numbered markers, or no visual labels.
controls.causalTest: Only label DOM changes; plane poses and source hashes remain identical.
